note: TestAutoPostBills.test_autopost_bills: an imported bill reads is_manually_modified after the importer filled it, so the autopost popup never appears. Pre-existing and older than it looks — until the add_where arity fix of 2026-08-30 this test ERRORED on tax prediction and never reached the assertion. _get_edi_creation not carrying skip_is_manually_modified is the obvious theory and is REFUTED: setting it there changes nothing, so the write that sets the flag is outside that block. Located 2026-09-03 by instrumenting AccountMove.write: the write that sets the flag comes from _check_taxes_country, a constraint, calling _update_tax_country_id, where tax_country_id is unprotected so the assignment is a real write. Consistent with the refutation above -- it is outside the _get_edi_creation block because it is not in the import path at all. Full account, including a READ-not-measured concern that concat returns self plus its arguments and so widens each assignment past its group, in the workspace CLAUDE.md known defects.
